test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: Which of the following remote controllers in split AC quickly maximises the cooling effect in any operation mode?
solution:
The correct answer is __Powerful operation**(Option 4)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Powerful operation__ is a feature in split ACs designed to quickly maximise the cooling effect.
 
• It overrides other settings temporarily to enhance performance and cool the room faster.
 
• Useful during extreme temperature conditions when immediate cooling is required.
 
• This mode works in conjunction with the AC's compressor and fan settings to achieve optimal results.
 
• It is typically activated by pressing the "Powerful" button on the remote controller.
 
• Once the desired temperature is reached, the AC may switch back to its normal operation mode.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Timer Cancel:**

 
 
• This button is used to cancel any pre-set timer settings on the AC.
 
• It does not influence the cooling power directly.
 
 
 
• **Mode Selector Button:**
 
 
• This button allows users to choose between different modes such as cool, heat, or fan.
 
• While it provides flexibility, it does not enhance cooling speed.
 
 
 
• **Swing:**
 
 
• The swing button adjusts the direction of airflow.
 
• It helps distribute air evenly but does not impact the cooling intensity.
